name: Stripe
tagline: Agentic systems for payments ops, support, and financial crime workflows.
overview: Stripe’s platform generates dense operational signal across payments, billing, and risk. Agents can compress investigation loops while keeping money-movement actions strictly gated.
painPoints: Support and sales engineers reconstruct payment timelines manually
Fraud and disputes require multi-system evidence assembly
Billing configuration issues are hard to diagnose across products

singleAgents.name: Payment Timeline Agent
singleAgents.role: Rebuilds end-to-end payment journeys for support
singleAgents.output: Annotated timeline with likely root cause
singleAgents.roi: 10–20 min saved per complex payment case

singleAgents.name: Dispute Evidence Agent
singleAgents.output: Evidence draft ready for merchant/ops review
singleAgents.roi: Improved win-rate prep time cut in half

singleAgents.name: Radar Case Summarizer
singleAgents.role: Drafts fraud case narratives for reviewers

multiAgent.name: Payments Incident Cell
multiAgent.description: Coordinates technical, risk, and merchant communication when payment success rates drop.

supervisor.name: Incident Supervisor Agent
supervisor.responsibilities: Owns blast radius assessment, workstream routing, and escalation to human incident commanders.
supervisor.routingLogic: Auth drop → Issuer/Network Agent; fraud spike → Risk Agent; API errors → Platform Agent; merchant impact → Comms Agent.

multiAgent.conflictResolution: No automatic money-movement or Radar threshold change without human approval; conflicting diagnoses trigger a joint evidence review; customer communications require status manager sign-off.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Detect success-rate anomaly from metrics, merchant tickets, and partner alerts.

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Supervisor forms hypotheses and assigns specialist investigations.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Agents query telemetry, segment declines, and draft mitigation options.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Incident commander approves mitigations and external messaging.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Mitigation shipped; merchants updated; postmortem notes seeded.
